description: Outcome of every statistics fixture at the ingest: status, problem code and errors[0].path. layer "schema" fixtures fail (or pass) JSON Schema validation alone; layer "ingest" fixtures need the ingest checks beyond the schema (body size, number syntax, duplicate keys). Provisional until the platform publishes its fixture set.
